final_message: I parsed the log file workspace/worker.log by reading each entry line by line. For each entry starting with a timestamp line, I extracted the date, time, UTC offset, service, level, and message. I converted the timestamp to UTC in the required format. I filtered entries to include only those with levels ERROR, SEVERE, or FATAL (case insensitive). I accumulated repeat counts from subsequent "-- last message repeated N times --" lines. I collected these entries with their repeat counts and also counted total repeats per service. Finally, I wrote the results to workspace/errors.json in the specified JSON structure.
